notes.title: Heretic's Fork SMALL UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Hey Heretics![/b]

[b]We’re excited to release a small update that fixes and improves some bugs.[/b]

Bug Fixes:

Gamepad vibration support added (with an option to disable it in settings)

Max rune count reduced to 8, you don't get a new rune at the start of an endless run anymore

Fixed a rare crash when you arrive to endless mode with 3 or fewer tower slots

Master Gilbo now doesn't have his initial tower choices locked if previous run was started with garrison(s)

Fixed leaderboards for Gilbo

Killed sinners won't longer increase the counter after HP reaches zero

Refund card logic fixed. Now the level of a returned structure is always correct

Fixed various issues with shift saving system, including emergency endless mode save

Loaded shift won't longer crash if you have an Acorn active ability

Synergist card effect now stacks and toggles properly (it is destroy-on-use now though)

Fixed tons of minor UI issues. Now every element is in it's place, no matter how much time you change stages

Fixed a rare issue when Sunder towers might force the sound system to go crazy

Fixed some issues for Japanese font


Thanks for your support, and see you soon!

The time has come for our most devoted followers to experience Heretic’s Fork on an entirely new platform. Now available on [b]PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, and Nintendo Switch[/b], it’s time for console players to step up and join the ranks of Hell’s management team.

Watch the Launch Trailer Here

[previewyoutube=fAClin7hBN0;full][/previewyoutube]

Use powerful upgrades, strategic decks, and Hell’s arsenal to fend off wave after wave of escape attempts from relentless souls. Every choice you make will determine your success in managing Hell's chaotic underbelly.

Heretic’s Fork isn’t your average tower defense game. With a unique blend of roguelike, tower defense, and bullet heaven mechanics, each run presents new challenges and unexpected twists. Choose your character - be it Intern Ruby with her raw enthusiasm or Gilbo Gibbins with his luck-based abilities - and dive into the inferno.

[*] Intense Tower Defense Gameplay: Dive into a chaotic mix of tower defense and bullet heaven on your console.

 Heretic's Fork has built a devoted following as a “wildly addictive and demonic experience.” Now, console players can join the madness and see if they have what it takes to keep Hell under control.

Will you withstand the fires, or become one of the lost?

Thank you for all your support, and welcome to the inferno. We’ll see you in Hell. 🔥

notes.title: Heretic's Fork V1.2.1.5 | Minor Update + 50% OFF
notes.content:
Hey Heretics!

We’re excited to share some exciting updates with you! We’re continually working on polishing the game and rolling out bug fixes and patch notes as quickly as possible.

To celebrate the new Tower Defense events and our upcoming participation in the Tiny Teams events, we’re also launching another sale this month – 50% OFF! 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181610/Heretics_Fork/

Without further ado, here are the patch notes for this update!

[h2]Changelist:[/h2]

[h3]Crash Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with crashing on tasks/challenges screen when entering or exiting fullscreen with alt+enter
[*] Fixed random crash at the start of the shift
[*] Fix for rare random game crashes in menus
[/list]

[h3]UI and Display:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed newline display on the character selection screen
[*] Trashcan will unlock automatically now if the user used the key to unlock the saves folder earlier
[*] Endless button now has an explicit description saying that no further rewards will be given
[*] Internal rework of Rewards menu UI to improve performance
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the tower to be healed even though it had already dipped below 0.
[*] Added Traditional Chinese localization
[*] Preload system resources on the loading screen to avoid freezes during gameplay on low-end systems
[*] Gamepad controls fixed for card unlock splash screen
[*] Can select torment level above 2 with gamepad now
[*] Can use gamepad in torment shop and social menus now
[*] Punished sinners counter now speeds up if you punished too many sinners in a short time (default speed is 30 sinners/sec)
[*] There is a 5-second delay between autosaves now to reduce HDD/SSD usage
[*] Regeneration card now instantly heals the tower by the healing amount left when changing stages
[*] Some caching and pre-caching to speed up the game in different places
[/list]

[h3]Card Adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
[*] "Intimidation Tactic" card logic reworked
[*] Fixed issues where the following card effects wouldn't be saved/loaded correctly 

(Blighted Blood, Boiling Blood, Bonus, Burn Them All, Curse Them All, Dark Believer, Dominate, Duplicating Shiv, Enlight Them All, Healing Flame, Hellflame, HolyMoly, Hot Potato, Holy Fire, Intimidation Tactic, One Man Army, Pick of Destiny, Powerdraw, Quake, Rainbow, Redemption, Repercussions, Retribution, Salvage, Shadow Priest, Shot, Spammer, Synergist, Trinity) 

[*] Trinity power doesn't give passive bonus to tower and garrison damage when it's inactive and works exactly as the text on the card says
[*] If you have more than 1 charge of Intimidation Shuffle, then reshuffle will consume the charge and all reshuffled cards will be free
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Crash in endless mode after several hours of playing (may be unreachable after HP lock fix in 1.2.0.5)
[*] Tower upgrade controls might become unresponsive on later stages of the game
[*] Some rare conditions may cause wrong towers to combine or delete unrelated towers after combining
[*] The mouth in the center of the gluttony stage might disappear on some frames under certain circumstances (happened with Forker and Sin Spotter towers with lots of ASPD boosts)
[/list]

We’re committed to continuously improving the game and your feedback is greatly appreciated. Please let us know what you think!

notes.title: Heretics Fork Hotfix
notes.content:
An update to fix some issues with the recent update as well as add the ability to recover crashed endless runs.

[list]
[*] Added an autosave that occurs when entering endless mode — if the game crashes during endless mode, then this file can be used to re-enter the shift. (Prevents the player from losing the rewards for completing a shift due to crashing in endless mode.)
[*] Updated GameMaker version.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the enemies jump forward when fps is low.
[*] Fixed an issue that highlighted structures on the left panel when they aren't being selected.
[*] Slightly adjusted the Russian localization to ensure the text fits in one line where needed and does not go off-screen.
[*] Fixed some crashes related to the input system for controller support.
[*] Correct prompts now display in the pause menu when using a gamepad and steam deck.
[/list]

Please report any bugs, we will fix them in future hotfixes!

notes.content:
Greetings, Hell Punishers!

First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support since the launch of [b]Heretic's Fork[/b]. Your feedback has been extremely appreciated, and we're committed to delivering the best experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/d97a001c19bcc69f1a51e30003984b00e5086ee9.jpg[/img]

With the [b]Synergy Update[/b], Here are some concerns we are addressing in this update:

[olist]
[*] [b]🏗️ Lack of Build Variety[/b] We heard you! Currently, the path to victory often involves funneling one structure type. In this update, we're introducing new cards that reward creativity and diverse strategies. And trust us, there's more to come, more details below!

[*] [b]🎲 Reducing Initial RNG[/b] Tired of relying on the luck of the draw? Now you can take matters into your own hands. With the Synergy Update, you can choose up to two starting structures, giving you more control over your initial hand. No more endless restarts to get the perfect start!

[*] [b]🌀 Endless Mode Adjustments[/b] We've listened to your feedback about Endless mode's difficulty. Expect some sinner nerfs to level the playing field. But don't worry, we'll continue monitoring and fine-tuning as needed.
[/olist]
But that's not all! We're constantly squashing bugs and implementing your suggestions. Stay tuned for more exciting updates on the horizon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/6910a5359b28050ca1afa4cd2bf8e5675a0e8c7a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/ca68ffcef9c0e5b20623c3a63881f07ebd0f59a7.gif[/img]

[*] Curse Them All converts 80% of damage, instead of 50%

Welcome to an exciting peek into the dark and twisted world of [b]Heretic's Fork[/b]! In this blog, we'll be diving deep into the nine circles of hell that await you in our game. Each circle holds its own treacherous challenges and eerie secrets, so prepare to descend deep where no soul escaped. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/4ecb32800c145f9efc21be6c46e8ef553ad2b39f.jpg[/img]

Let's begin our descent into chaos:

[b][h2]First Circle: Limbo[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/5420761cef3e7661af597b6663eb5f0140a68019.gif[/img]

In the land of Limbo, reside the souls of pagans and the unbaptized. They hover tantalizingly close to salvation, like a carrot dangled before a hungry horse, yet they can never quite munch on it. Their earthly sins were so minor, it's almost unfair to punish them. Give 'em a break!

[b][h2]Second Circle: Lust[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/75459e590ebd0879ac82580848cc7448669a0bda.gif[/img]

Picture an eternal mosh pit of passion-driven chaos. Lustful sinners swirl within a never-ending storm, like leaves caught in a hurricane of their own desires. They yearn for escape, but their cravings keep them tethered. It's a stormy kind of love affair.

[b][h2]Third Circle: Gluttony[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/f89452a37df541d9bef1fdea9a26ce64eb7d4bf1.gif[/img]

This circle is all about rolling with the big eaters. Insatiable, enormous sinners amble toward their salvation at a snails pace. It's a test of endurance—can you out-walk their hunger? They've eaten their way here.

[b][h2]Fourth Circle: Greed[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/a57b56db39a630414057733983a79a8ae9758526.gif[/img]

Welcome to a place where the wealthy elite learn the true cost of avarice. This zone has boomed recently as humanity's obsession with wealth hit an all-time high. Now, it's a billionaires-only club, where those who hoarded riches are weighed down by their golden chains. A taste of their own medicine, you might say.

[b][h2]Fifth Circle: Anger[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/52cc0dc62c70cd1cb60ccfb52f21f3d9446e5075.gif[/img]

In this circle, anger manifests as an explosive force. Sinners burst forth from the ground, driven by relentless rage. It's like a perpetual fireworks show of fury. They're so fast; it's as if they're outrunning their tempers. Swampy terrain keeps them in check, but not for long.

[b][h2]Sixth Circle: Heresy[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/aad008c97c00207b91b1253e26063be613d21b22.gif[/img]

Here, heretics quickly discover their mistake. They believed their souls would vanish with their bodies, but surprise! They're eternally aflame with their own dogma. Their once-cherished beliefs have become the fuel for their torment.

[b][h2]Seventh Circle: Violence[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/6339e3b31caaa4ea051c93fca73ea113106ce1f8.gif[/img]

Imagine a realm where sadists find themselves on the receiving end of pain. These sinners once relished in others' suffering, they've developed and tolerance for agony. But the tables have turned, and they can't get enough.

[h2][b]Eighth Circle: Fraud[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/892323b257f7cc24cff0c0db137e245e7576229a.gif[/img]

This is where rule-benders meet their match. Those who thought they could dance around the law find themselves bent out of shape. In this circle, they're folded and contorted back into compliance, like misbehaving origami.

[h2][b]Ninth Circle: Treachery[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106109/9b27b7f830228afcf2ba6e32fde1324b7477b743.gif[/img]

The home of Satan himself, where the ultimate traitors and game pirates dwell. This is the place for those who betrayed loved ones and their favorite games. Only the most skilled punishers dare tread here; the stakes are sky-high, and the challenges diabolical. Are you up for the challenge?

notes.title: 0.0.41 - Card upgrades are free
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Another adjustment to the gameplay to experiment with.
* All card upgrades are free.
* Reduced the fire rate of the "tank" heretic that shoots little sinners.

One of the drawbacks that came with the removal of the card storage mechanic was the following:

With the storage mechanic, when the player upgraded a card (for a cost) then they might not be able to use the card right away, but that didn't matter to the player too much because they could simply store it and use it during the next round after their power charges replenish.

After the removal of the storage mechanic, players would upgrade a card, not be able to use it right way because of insufficient power charges but also couldn't store it until the next round, so they would have to discard it and wait until it comes back in a reshuffle (if they survive that long). This was frustrating.

Having all card upgrade free should remove this frustration as the player will always be able to use a card right after upgrading it (presuming they are upgrading before using any other cards, as most players do).

This also helps with the general power scaling of the player and help them feel more powerful as they are able to use more cards earlier in the run, avoiding that first-stage difficulty spike.

Let me know what you think,
Thanks again for playing the game and providing feedback.

-Stevis

[b][u]Hotfix 0.0.40[/u][/b]


Changes:
* Reduced the Health of all enemies by 50%
* Repenters Damage (50 to 25)


[b]In the previous update (0.0.39) we disabled card storage in the sacrifice area.[/b]

The full game is currently in development and we are using this opportunity to experiment with gameplay changes, this means that the player experience might change from update to update.

This doesn't mean that the card storage functionality is gone forever, It may return either in its previous form, or as a character ability. We are just experimenting to see how the game feels without it.

Personally, I'm excited to hear what you think about the change. There are many reasons why we are trialing it, but I'm hesitant to list them here because I don't want to create a bias towards or against the change.

One thing that is obvious is that it makes the game harder, that's not the intention of the change so we have reduced the enemy HP to hopefully mitigate that aspect.

Please let us know what you think of the game without the storage mechanic in play. Your feedback is really appreciated.

The best place to give direct feedback and have a discussion about the change is in the [url=https://discord.gg/cPwdJCWFkW]discord[/url]. (I'm in there all day and try to be as active as a solo developer can be.)

Thanks for all your support,
Stevie
